package.name: wamoduck_msgs
package.description:
Messages for the Wamoduck (wmduck) ROS 2 link.
JointTarget is the ROS-side image of the TYPE_CMD (0x01) payload of the deployment protocol v1: a 40-byte payload carried inside a 46-byte frame, sent host -> cerebellum at 50 Hz. Keeping the message semantic (radians, SI twist) means the bridge node is the only component that knows about fixed-point scaling and byte order.
LinkStatus carries the byte-level link counters and the cerebellum status word that the bridge/safety side needs to publish for diagnostics.
